follow-on: all six added ids are 0/5 alone at both revisions, yet 3/3 loaded candidate runs failed at least one and 0/3 loaded base runs failed any (repeats2/summary.txt), and the node labels them load-only without measuring whether the candidate's new test module - whose module-scoped fixture redirects RECKON_HOME and creates real repositories - is itself what destabilises its siblings under -n 10, so a candidate-introduced load interaction is left as an untested alternative to pure load and the node's central verdict is weaker than its wording.

follow-on: changed_paths reads "none" while eleven artifacts were written into the granted report scope, so a coordinator reconciling the record against the tree cannot tell that the report directory was written.

item_verdicts.goal: the node goal (prompt.txt:30) is to measure the importer population of the held-worktree record index at base and at its merge candidate on an exclusive node; the manifest's landing, tests and artifacts lines (manifest.md:10-11,18) report exactly that measurement and name the six added ids.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md records both arms' summaries with EXIT codes and log paths (manifest.md:11-12), the six added ids each with a verdict and a per-id failure_attribution (manifest.md:17), the five candidate-only setup errors, the one scaffolding retry, and the follow-on naming the new test file's RECKON_HOME fixture.

justifications.durability: the reviewed node adds no code and so adds no regression assertion, and its central finding rests on six ids that failed 0/5 alone at both revisions (repeats/summary.txt:1-12), so a re-run need not reproduce the count it recorded.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log and gate-candidate.log carry the revision, host, literal command and MODULE_FILE headers the done_when requires and end EXIT=1, and repeats/summary.txt records 0/5 failed runs at each revision for all six added ids.
justifications.fit: the manifest and its id lists follow the dispatch manifest contract with no symbol, file or comment a naming rule forbids.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the source manifest's tests line (manifest.md:11) reports "1 failed, 917 passed" at ae915f67c against "7 failed, 911 passed, 5 errors" at 4babb5fee and names the six added ids, which is the base-versus-candidate attribution the goal states.
justifications.reuse: the node adds no definition that could fork an owner, and the durable added-failure record it feeds is reduced by the existing owner reckon/crew/review.py:2100 added_failures_from_gate_logs, which over these two logs returns the same six ids.
